   171	    def _analyse(self, plan, key, values):
   172	        """`(accepts, filters accept, status, cost, commands)` per input.
   173	
   174	        The verdict depends only on the recovered input values, so it is
   175	        cached by corpus identity and shared by every witness of one input.
   176	        """
   177	        module = plan.module
   178	        accepted = True

   180	            accepted = False
   181	        filters = True
   182	        if accepted or plan.flag is not None:
   183	            filters = self._filters_accept(plan, values)
   184	        if not accepted or not filters:
   185	            return (accepted, filters, "FILTERED", 0, [])
   186	        if self.machine is None:
   187	            return (accepted, filters, "OK", 0, [])
   188	        preparation = self._preparation.get(key, _MISSING)
   189	        if preparation is _MISSING:
   190	            preparation = self._prepare(plan, values)
   191	            self._preparation[key] = preparation
   192	        if preparation is None:
   193	            return (accepted, filters, "UNREACHABLE", 0, [])

   195	        message = values.get(self.machine.message_param)
   196	        if not isinstance(message, str):

   198	        return (accepted, filters, "OK", cost, list(commands) + [message])

   200	    def _filters_accept(self, plan, values):
   201	        """Every composed filter application accepts, transitively."""
   202	        for name, mapping in plan.apps:
   203	            module = self.modules[name]
   204	            predicate = module.requires
   205	            if predicate is None:
   206	                continue
   207	            environment = {}
   208	            for pname, _ in module.params:
   209	                source = mapping.get(pname)
   210	                if source is None:
   211	                    return False
   212	                environment[pname] = values[source]
   213	            if not predicate(environment):
   214	                return False
   215	        return True
